answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral, creating a gale of economic pressure against malicious actors. Like a raven circling a decentralized ledger, the system validates nodes based on weight rather than identity. The integrity of this quartz stable consensus depends on the cost of acquiring tokens, which makes spawning infinite fake identities prohibitively expensive, as attackers would need to secure a majority of the total staked assets to manipulate the network.
